_meta: Hover-glossary definitions. 'cs' = case-sensitive match (default true for capitalized terms). Terms matched longest-first.

terms.def: Reaction: attack an enemy who voluntarily leaves your reach. Costs 1 focus.
Action: test a skill vs. a defense to gain an advantage on your next test against that enemy using a different skill.
Action: make a skill test outside of combat actions (Crafting, Medicine, Deception, etc.).
An action that doesn't consume one of your actions for the turn. Usable once per trigger unless stated otherwise.
A die (determined by Willpower) rolled on short rest or Recover action. Split the result between health and focus recovery.
A d6 rolled alongside the d20 when the GM raises the stakes. Faces: Opportunity, Complication (+2 or +4), or blank.
A GM action that triggers rolling the plot die alongside the d20 on a test.
1+ uninterrupted hour. Roll your recovery die to recover health and/or focus.
8+ uninterrupted hours. Recover all health and focus; reduce Exhausted by 1.
Terrain that costs double movement to traverse.
Terrain that deals damage when entered or when a turn starts there.
Skill (Strength): used for attacks with heavy or two-handed weapons.
Skill (Speed): used for attacks with light, finesse, or ranged weapons.
A Medicine expertise for treating psychological trauma and stress.
Attribute (Physical): determines max health, lifting capacity, and unarmed damage.
Attribute (Physical): determines movement rate.
Attribute (Cognitive): governs Cognitive skills like Crafting, Deduction, Lore, Medicine.
Attribute (Cognitive): determines max focus and recovery die size.
Attribute (Spiritual): determines senses range.
Attribute (Spiritual): governs social and Spiritual skills.
Defense affected by Strength and Speed. Resists bodily attacks.
Defense affected by Intellect and Willpower. Resists mental influence.
Defense affected by Awareness and Presence. Resists soul-targeting effects.
Condition: take ongoing damage each turn. Bracket lists type and amount (e.g. Afflicted [1d4 vital]).
Condition: when you fail a test, add an Opportunity to the result. Condition then ends.
Condition: no reactions; senses obscured; Perception tests have disadvantage.
Condition: advantage on all tests; Investiture refills each turn. Granted by swearing an Ideal. Lasts until end of scene.
Condition: a specified attribute gains a bonus. Cumulative across attributes.
Condition: apply penalty to test results. Cumulative. Reduce by 1 after each long rest.
Condition: abilities that cost focus cost 1 less.
Condition: movement rate becomes 0. Can't move or be moved.
Condition: lying flat; Slowed; melee attacks against you have advantage; can Brace without cover.
Condition: movement 0; disadvantage on all tests except escape attempts.
Condition: movement rate halved.
Condition: lose reactions; gain two fewer actions; don't gain a reaction.
Condition: lose reactions; can't take fast turn; gain one fewer action. Removed after your next turn.
Condition: movement 0; can't communicate; fall Prone; drop items.
Condition (homebrew): reduced effectiveness. Used by Black leyline talents.
Skill (Speed): acrobatics, balance, and nimble movement.
Skill (Strength): climbing, jumping, swimming, and feats of raw power.
Skill (Speed): moving unseen and unheard.
Skill (Intellect): creating and repairing items.
Skill (Intellect): logical reasoning, investigation, and analysis.
Skill (Willpower): mental fortitude, concentration, and resisting influence.
Skill (Willpower): coercion through threat or force of personality.
Skill (Intellect): knowledge of history, cultures, and arcana.
Skill (Intellect): treating wounds, illness, and injuries.
Skill (Presence): lying, disguise, and misdirection.
Skill (Awareness): reading people, detecting lies, sensing motives.
Skill (Presence): inspiring, commanding, and coordinating allies.
Skill (Awareness): noticing hidden things, spotting danger, sensory acuity.
Skill (Presence): convincing others through charm or reason.
Skill (Awareness): tracking, foraging, navigating wilderness.
A beneficial side effect on a test. Spend it to: Aid an Ally, Collect Yourself, Critically Hit, or Influence the Narrative.
A negative side effect on a test (also grants +2 or +4 to the roll). GM spends it for hindrances.
Spiritual resource fueling leyline talents. Recovered by Drawing Mana. Max = 2 + higher of AWA or PRE.
The form of Investiture on Roshar. Stored in infused spheres, breathed in by Radiants.
A Knight Radiant progression step. Swearing an Ideal grants the Empowered condition.
A legendary weapon manifested from a bonded spren. Deals spirit damage, severing the soul.
Magical armor granting immense deflect and strength. Cracks under damage, regenerates with Stormlight.
Your rank in the leyline color skill that powers this talent. Determines scaling for [Die], [Size], and Attunement Range.
Radius scaling with leyline color rank: 15 / 30 / 60 / 90 / 120 ft at ranks 1–5.
1 Action: recover Investiture equal to your Tier and trigger your leyline color's Attunement rider.
Deity resource (Death domain): a token left when a creature dies near you. Consumed by Morrath talents for effects.
Deity resource (Destruction domain): accumulated through combat escalation. Spent by Razkael talents for burst damage.
Deity terrain effect: a zone consecrated by your deity talents. Allies in it gain benefits; enemies suffer penalties.
Deity terrain effect: a trap zone that triggers when enemies enter. Used by several deity and leyline talents.
Action: move 5 ft without triggering Reactive Strikes.
Action: take cover within 5 ft; attacks against you have disadvantage while you stay.
Reaction: spend 1 focus to impose a disadvantage on an attack against you.
Reaction: spend 1 focus to grant an ally advantage on an upcoming skill test.
2 Actions: roll your recovery die and recover health and/or focus.
Action: test Athletics vs. Physical to Restrain the target (and yourself).
Action: push a creature 5 ft or knock them Prone.
When an attack misses, spend 1 focus to deal damage-dice only (no skill modifier). Always lowercase.
Armor value that reduces incoming energy, impact, and keen damage. Vital and spirit bypass it.
Cognitive resource for abilities and resisting influence. Max = 2 + Willpower. Recovered by resting.
Physical resource representing stamina. Max = 10 + Strength. Recovered by resting.
Test modifier: roll an extra die, keep the better result (player's choice).
Test modifier: roll an extra die, keep the worse result (GM's choice).
Specialized knowledge granting unique tests and free recall of basic facts in a topic.
Suffered at 0 health or when struck at 0 health. Roll d20 to determine duration and severity.
